name: Humanitarian funding gap
value: WFP Gaza aid cut for 500k (19 Oct)
summary: Funding gaps force WFP ration cuts in Gaza and the West Bank
state: WFP said on 19 Oct it would cut monthly food aid in Gaza from 1.6 million to 1.1 million people and halve family rations, after receiving less than half its usual Palestine funding in 2026; it needs $450m for six months. West Bank aid was halved in September (Al Jazeera).
for_you: Funding shortfalls reduce aid in crisis zones. OCHA and ReliefWeb publish appeal details.

sources.title: Al Jazeera — WFP cuts aid to 500,000 Palestinians in Gaza amid funding shortages

why: When appeals go unfunded, food aid and health services are cut first; funding gaps lead famine and displacement by months.
drivers: Donor budgets and aid cuts, new crises competing for funds, access constraints.

rubric.alert: Pipeline breaks forcing large-scale suspension of food or health aid in famine-risk countries.
rubric.watch: Funding more than 10 percentage points behind recent years at the same point, or major ration cuts announced.
rubric.normal: UN global appeal funding in line with recent years; no major ration cuts.
